سیدنا حسین حسین ۔۔۔
مرقد کی وحشتوں کا مجھے کوئی غم نہیں
اپنی مصیبتوں کا مجھے کوئی غم نہیں

سیدنا حسین حسین ۔۔۔
یہ جستجو یہ حق کی طلبگار کم نہ ہو
مولا تمہارے گھر سے وفادار کم نہ ہو
مشکل ہو کوئی بھی یہ عزادار کم نہ ہو
کرتے ہیں بس خدا سے عزادار یہ دعا
سیدنا حسین حسین ۔۔۔
موج ستم اٹھی بھی تو ساحل نہ چھو سکی

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/syedna-husain.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
head, roman, body = before.decode().split('---', 2)
metadata, verses = roman.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
changes = {
'Meri bakshish ka waseela': 'Meri bakhshish ka wasila',
'Har ghari mera wazeefa': 'Har ghari mera wazifa',
'Mere har gham ka madawa': 'Mere gham ka madaawa',
'Kis se misaal doo teri kis meiṅ karuṅ shumaar': 'Kis se misaal duṅ teri kis meiṅ karuṅ shumaar',
'Riffat ko teri dekh ke kehti hai karbala': 'Rifat ko teri dekh ke kehti hai Karbala',
'Auje hussainiyat meiṅ na dekha gaya zawaal': 'Auj-e-Husainiyat meiṅ na dekha gaya zawaal',
'Tere udu ka hissa khata o saza zawaal': 'Tere adu ka hissa khata o saza zawaal',
'Har daur teri jit hai har daur karbala': 'Har daur teri jit hai har daur Karbala',
'Hojata sab halaak tabahi ke zad meiṅ tha': 'Ho jaata sab halaak tabaahi ke zid meiṅ tha',
'Din e rasul e pak tabahi ke zad meiṅ tha': 'Din-e-Rasul-e-Paak tabaahi ke zid meiṅ tha',
'Insan dard naak tabahi ke zad meiṅ tha': 'Insaan dardnaak tabaahi ke zid meiṅ tha',
'Jaaṅ de ke tune bakshi hai har ek ko jila': 'Jaaṅ de ke tu ne bakhshi hai har ek ko jila',
'Hurr aaya jab hai shaam ke lashkar ko chor kar': 'Hurr aaya jab hai Shaam ke lashkar ko chhor kar',
'Rab ki qasam hai raahe jina saath aap ka': 'Rab ki qasam hai raah-e-jinaaṅ saath aap ka',
'Deta har ek gham ko tera gham hai hausla': 'Deta hai har ek gham ko tera gham hai hausla',
'Ye justaju ye haq ki talabgari kam na ho': 'Ye justaju ye haq ki talabgaar kam na ho',
'Maula tumhare ghar se wafadari kam na ho': 'Maula tumhaare ghar se wafadaar kam na ho',
'Mushkil ho koi bhi ye azadari kam na ho': 'Mushkil ho koi bhi ye azaadaar kam na ho',
'Karte hai bas khuda se azadar ye dua': 'Karte haiṅ bas Khuda se azaadaar ye dua',
'Mauj e sitam uthi bhi to saahil na chu saki': 'Mauj-e-sitam uthi bhi to saahil na chhu saki',
'Kaali ghatayeiṅ zulm ki har simt cha gayi': 'Kaali ghataaeṅ zulm ki har simt chhaa gaiṅ',
'Lekin teri shuwaoṅ ki hadh tak na aa saki': 'Lekin teri shuaaoṅ ki had tak na aa saki',
'Suraj teri hayaat ka rashan raha sada': 'Suraj teri hayaat ka raushan raha sadaa',
'Bete ka laasha dosh pe tha rab ka shukriya': 'Bete ka laasha dosh pe tha Rab ka shukriya',
'Karke supurd khaak kiya rab ka shukriya': 'Kar ke supurd-e-khaak kiya Rab ka shukriya',
'Har gaam pe tu karta raha rab ka shukriya': 'Har gaam pe tu karta raha Rab ka shukriya',
'Tujhko salaam sabr o tahammul ne khud kiya': 'Tujh ko salaam sabr o tahammul ne khud kiya',
'Itni kahaṅ thi fikre shanwar ki riffateiṅ': 'Itni kahaaṅ thi fikr-e-Shanaawar ki rifateṅ',
'Aamir jo zam Husain ki karta ye azmateiṅ': 'Aamir jo zam Husain ki karta ye azmateṅ',
'Unki nawazisheiṅ hai ye unki inayateiṅ': 'Un ki nawaazisheṅ haiṅ ye un ki inaayateṅ',
'Socha tha bas Husain ko aur misra hogaya': 'Socha tha bas Husain ko aur misra ho gaya',
}
lines = [line.removeprefix('  ') for line in verses.splitlines()]
assert changes.keys() <= set(lines)
revised = [changes.get(line, line).removesuffix('...') for line in lines]
revised = [line.removesuffix(' nahi') + ' nahiṅ' if line.endswith(' nahi') else line for line in revised]
assert len(revised) == len(body.strip().splitlines())
p.write_bytes((head + '---' + metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + ''.join('  ' + line + '\\n' for line in revised) + '---' + body).encode())
after = p.read_bytes()
assert after.split(b'---', 2)[2] == before.split(b'---', 2)[2]
assert after.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == before.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0]
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for line in revised for c in line)
print(f'Checked {len(revised)-1} paired verses; Urdu body and other metadata byte-identical.')
PY

item.text:
Audited all 51 Roman verses against the Urdu in [syedna-husain.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/bab1ba5ba49f493a80c3ac1d1514ceb1/src/data/lyrics/syedna-husain.md). Corrected mismatched words, nasal endings, izafat, and house spelling. Verified that the Urdu body and other metadata are byte-for-byte unchanged.

Retained the existing reading `zam` for `زم` in the closing verse. Its pronunciation remains uncertain and needs editorial sign-off.
